adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, when `content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1`, the code always calls `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)` immediately after `revisor.revise!(...)` without checking whether `revise!` actually applied/persisted the revision. The diff shows `PostRevisor#revise!` can return `false` early (`return false if not should_revise?`), so there is a plausible inconsistency risk (hash updated even if no revision occurred). However, the finding’s specific scenario about a save being “halted” is not directly shown here (exceptions would prevent `update_column`), so it’s more of a robustness/edge-case concern than a clearly verifiable defect from the diff alone.
